The 30 drawings cover these subsystems:

| Subsystem | Drawings | Count |
|---|---:|---:|
| Enclosure / box | D-001–D-005 | 5 |
| Powder handling | D-006–D-010 | 5 |
| Recoater | D-011–D-015 | 5 |
| Optics | D-016–D-020 | 5 |
| Gas flow | D-021–D-022 | 2 |
| Build plate | D-023–D-028 | 6 |
| Z-axis | D-029–D-030 | 2 |
| **Total** |  | **30** |

The BOM has **two groups of Z-axis-related rows**: the build-platform lift assembly and rows explicitly named for the SensorGantry Z-axis.

| BOM row | Why it’s Z-axis-related | Corresponding drawing in the supplied set |
|---|---|---|
| Build base | Supports the build platform and contains the lift/heater features | **D-024 — ByggeBase** |
| Build cylinder clamp ring | Holds the build cylinder and locates the Z-axis motor assembly | **D-027 — Cylinder Spænd Ring** |
| Motor plate | Holds the three non-captive Z-axis stepper motors and end stops | **D-030 — Z-axis MotorPlate** |
| Motor plate shaft | Shaft for the build-platform lift assembly | No clear matching drawing |
| NEMA 23 Tr11x2 Non-Captive | The three lift motors | No clear matching drawing |
| Self-centering keyless bushing | Coupling in the build-platform drive assembly | No clear matching drawing |
| Z axis linear rod *(SensorGantry)* | Explicitly a Z-axis component | No clear match |
| Z axis stepper bracket *(SensorGantry)* | Explicitly a Z-axis component | No clear match |
| Z axis linear stepper *(SensorGantry)* | Explicitly a Z-axis component | No clear match |
| Z axis guide clamp *(SensorGantry)* | Explicitly a Z-axis component | No clear match |
| Z axis linear guide *(SensorGantry)* | Explicitly a Z-axis component | No clear match |

The supplied drawings also include **D-029 — Z-axis BottomPlate**, but the BOM has no row with that name, so I can’t confidently match it to a BOM item. **D-025 — Build Base Ring** is likewise a drawing without an obvious same-named BOM row.

The recoater is made up of the following parts:

**Fabricated parts shown in the drawings**
- Recoater arm (D-011)
- Recoater mount block (D-012)
- Recoater adjustment plate (D-013)
- Recoater linear/stage plate (D-014)
- Two silicone wipers (D-015)

**Other recoater parts listed in the BOM**
- Recoater head and silicone-wiper clamp
- Recoater wall and end-stop bracket
- Two 20 mm linear shafts, two double linear bushings, and four shaft supports
- NEMA 23 stepper motor and driver
- T5 belt, motor pulley, idler, idler pin and spacer, and two belt-clamp plates

Together, these form the blade/head assembly, its guided sliding stage, and the belt-driven motion system.
Drawing D-014, **RecoaterStagePlate.pdf**.
Drawing D-010 documents the **Powder stepper bracket** BOM row.
D-030, **Z-axis_MotorPlate**. D-029 is the **Z-axis BottomPlate**.

**Mostly, but not completely.** The BOM lists a front and back door, both aluminium, which is broadly consistent with drawing D‑001’s “Door – x2” and its 3 mm aluminium specification. The BOM distinguishes them—the front door has a viewing window, the back door does not—but D‑001 describes two doors without showing or specifying that difference.

The hole detail does agree: D‑001 calls the holes “THRU ALL,” so they are unthreaded, as the BOM notes.
The Left Side Box interfaces with the Print Platform, Top Side, Front Side Box, and Back Box.

The **Left Side Box, Front Side Box, Back Box, and Right Box** connect to the print platform, according to the BOM’s interface listings. The platform also serves as the interface between the **Z-axis, recoater, and powder-handling system**.
The cylinder clamp ring clamps the build cylinder to the build platform. It also locates and holds the Z-axis motor assembly, including the build-base linear stage.
The 1 mm silicone wiper is held by an aluminium recoater clamp. The wiper drawing shows eight through-holes for fastening it to the clamp.
No. The BOM lists the recoater arm as aluminium, and its drawing specifies an aluminium plate.

The drawing specifies **AISI 316 stainless-steel sheet** and also notes that build plates are to be made in **stainless steel and aluminium**. The BOM lists **stainless steel and steel**, but not aluminium. So they agree that a steel plate is intended, but **do not fully agree**: the drawing calls for an aluminium version too.

The BOM identifies these parts as silicone or silicone rubber:

- **Recoater Blade** — silicone sheet, 1 mm thick.
- **Silicone gasket f-theta** — 1 mm silicone rubber.
- **Tri-Clamp silicone gasket** — silicone sealing gasket.

The **Silicone sheet** entry is raw material used for gaskets. The BOM also lists **DOWSIL 7091** silicone sealant, which is a consumable rather than a machine part.
The laser source was supplied by **Max Photonics** and cost **DKK 45,000**.

The Box subsystem totals **DKK 5,627** when summing the BOM’s recorded **Total cost** values for Box-family items.

That figure is incomplete: several custom-fabricated Box parts are listed with **DKK 0** cost, including the side and back panels, print platform, window frame, and bracing. It therefore does not include their material, fabrication, or labor costs. The M5×12 button-head screws also have no recorded total cost.
They used order number **180-9104** for the M5 nuts for the 2020 profile.
No. The recoater DM332T is listed at **DKK 96.00**, while the build-plate DM332T is **DKK 99.42** per unit.
The BOM lists the oxygen sensor at **DKK 5,500**.
D-030 does not state a readable weight in the supplied drawing text.
The recoater arm weighs approximately **415.3 g**.
Sheet 2 is at **1:1 scale**.
The build cylinder’s inside should be smooth, with a surface roughness of **Ra 0.4–0.8 µm**.
The documents do not specify a tensile strength for the build plate. Drawing D-026 identifies it as AISI 316 stainless steel sheet.

The recoater mount block is **Drawing D-012, RecoaterMountBlock**. It’s an aluminium block that connects the recoater stage plate to the arm.

```text
       Recoater mount block — schematic, not to scale

        ┌──────────────────────────────┐
        │                              │
        │   M6 threaded holes          │
        │                              │
        └──────────────────────────────┘
        ←──────── 120 mm ─────────────→
                 40 mm wide
```

The drawing specifies an approximately **25 mm** block height and **two sets of M6 threaded holes** (pilot holes Ø5 mm). The BOM lists the material as aluminium; the drawing specifies **EN-AW 5005**.
The heating element plate is **2–3 mm thick**; drawing D-028 labels its thickness as **3.0 / 2.0 mm**.

It’s a thin annular plate with **8 through-holes**, each with a **Ø6.9 mm, 90° countersink**. The drawing specifies **Ø250 mm outside**, **Ø224 mm inside**, and a hole-pattern radius of **115.5 mm**. The ring is aluminium.

**Corrected:** The Build Plate material is **aluminium**, not stainless steel.

Update the BOM’s **Build Plate** material to “Aluminium” and revise drawing D-026’s material callout from “AISI 316 Stainless Steel Sheet (SS)” to “Aluminium.” The documents don’t specify the aluminium alloy grade.
